Your shoulders should mimic the angle of the jump cue as much as possible.    Do this by raising the back shoulder as you Jack the butt of the cue up, while lowering the front shoulder.  

Aim before you elevate the cue by siting down the shot as if it was a normal shot and the obstructing ball wasn’t there.  Pick a spot on that line within six inches or so of the cue ball.   Aim to jump over that spot.  Aiming at the actual OB will hurt your neck once you Jack up.  

Confidence in the jump is key.  If you have doubts it won’t work.  So just go into it confident it will work.  Being a dumb optimist helps tremendously.  

Your stroke doesn’t have to be real hard and you are probably elevating higher than you need.  I picture the cue ball as an apple and pretend you are trying to spear the Apple to its core with the jump cue.  That is basically the stroke you need.  

Your contact point is one of the hardest parts to find.  The easiest way is to pick what angle you want to hit the CB and you’re a line at that angle going directly through the center of the CB. Then raise the cue up about one tip above that. 

Do not have a death grip on the back hand.  Should be holding butt lightly and swinging it at the CB.

Weren’t exactly same number of questions as people in class but close.  After the class we all met, compiled the test from everyone’s memory, using the overlap to double check what each question was.  We also had one guy in the class that had close to a photographic memory so was able to validate the whole thing and fix some spots where the two people on a given question couldn’t agree.  We then as a group worked the problems as a group and everyone had a copy of the test and an answer key to memorize.  

Educator also allowed students to play tapes in a portable cassette player if they showed her the tape was a purchased prerecorded tape.  I showed people how to tape over the holes that made recorders think it was a writable tape.  Then they could record over a crappy three dollar bargain bin tape with whatever they want.  Say the answers to thirty chemistry final questions hypothetically.  So even those who had bad memories and didn’t understand the material were able to ace the test.
